description: REPLACES the http/https listener's rules: each sends a hostname and/or path prefix to an http pool (up to 25). They are evaluated most specific first, whatever the order sent; anything unmatched goes to the default pool. No wildcard hostname on https. Each https hostname gets a certificate once it points to the load balancer. Scope: network.write.

lb.description: Load balancer id, as returned by list_load_balancers or create_load_balancer.

hostname.description: e.g. app.example.com, or *.example.com on http only.

name: set_rules
title: Set the routing rules of a listener
